cells.What Tron does with it: It is the last part of the run link `<server>/<repository>/actions/runs/<run id>`. `background-check.sh` keeps its state under `background-checks-<run id>-<attempt>-<job>`. `publish_regional.py` starts its `nonce` text with it.
It is the first part of the run link `<server>/<repository>/actions/runs/<run id>`. The link goes into the Slice cost-data refresh summary, its health issue text and the CI model cache journal.

`hf_cache.py` writes it as the Tron commit into the journal and ledger of the CI model cache. On `main`, `prime_hf_models.py` compares the model input files at this commit with those at the current `main` commit.

`bench-refresh-ci.sh` appends its summary text to this file. `run-lint-checks.sh` appends a failure summary when the lint build fails. `bench_refresh_bitfile.py` appends a section `Refresh runner bitfile`. One step of `bench-refresh.yml` appends a dry-run note.
The script prints the value in the `ci` field of its `cache_context` log line. Nothing else changes.

CI steps pass it as `--workspace` to `test_runtime.py` and `benchmark_runtime.py` in `bin/ci/tron-build`. They also build paths below it: `bin/.venv/bin` for `PATH`, `.nix-gcroots` for cleanup, and `.slice-refresh-base`.
